info.title: STAS Intervals Gateway
info.description: Gateway for Intervals.icu planned workouts (read/write/delete) + STAS DB endpoints. Auth via OAuth2.

get.summary: Get current user identity from JWT token
Get the authoritative footer before every reply
get.description: Call before every final reply. Render only chatFooter after the answer. If absent, omit the footer and never invent links.

404.description: Summary is not available yet; chatFooter may still be present

get.summary: Get detailed package for one completed training
get.description: Read-only detailed package for one selected completed workout. Use after getTrainings identifies the exact training_id. Do not batch this action across many workouts. The response omits rawData, route coordinates, latlng, and raw stream arrays.

parameters.name: training_id
parameters.description: Training id returned by trainings actions. Load trainings first to identify the exact completed workout.

200.description: Detailed activity package for one selected workout

404.description: Training not found for current user

get.description: Read profile/rules only when needed to compose or explain a draft. Do not call this after explicit save intent; saveProfileSection reads the current section internally.
Read a compact paginated history index. Full texts and hashes are omitted; use readProfileChangeDetail for one selected record.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: nextCursor from the previous page.

post.description: Restore one committed change only after readProfileChangeDetail and explicit confirmation of the exact previous text.

parameters.name: changeId
parameters.description: Committed profile memory change id.

parameters.name: days
parameters.description: Return planned events for last N days window (relative). If omitted, can use oldest/newest.

parameters.name: oldest
parameters.description: Oldest date (YYYY-MM-DD) inclusive.

parameters.name: newest
parameters.description: Newest date (YYYY-MM-DD) inclusive.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Exact Intervals event id to delete. Safest selector for one known event, e.g. 116577024. Can be comma-separated for multiple exact ids.

parameters.name: external_id
parameters.description: Exact external_id to delete, e.g. test:write-check:2026-06-18. Can be comma-separated or repeated as external_ids.

parameters.name: external_ids
parameters.description: Comma-separated exact external_id values to delete. Use only when every value is known exactly.

parameters.name: external_id_prefix
parameters.description: Delete only events whose external_id starts with this prefix, e.g. plan: or test:. Requires oldest and newest. Gateway re-filters by external_id prefix before deleting.

parameters.name: oldest
parameters.description: Oldest date (YYYY-MM-DD) inclusive. Required with external_id_prefix; optional narrowing window with external_id.

parameters.name: newest
parameters.description: Newest date (YYYY-MM-DD) inclusive. Required with external_id_prefix; optional narrowing window with external_id.

parameters.name: dry_run
parameters.description: Required false for this single confirmed deletion.

delete.description: Call once to delete only the exact STAS-managed scope explicitly requested. Gateway resolves targets and deletes internally. Do not call calendar reads, delete previews, or readback in the delete turn.

post.description: An explicit request to save the exact understood events is sufficient confirmation. Call once with dry_run=false. Gateway normalizes, deduplicates, writes, and returns the result. Do not read the calendar, preview, or read back in the save turn.

parameters.name: dry_run
parameters.description: Required false for this single confirmed write.

get.summary: Get a bounded comparative list of historical workouts and calendar context
get.description: Read workouts plus NOTE/SICK/INJURED/HOLIDAY context. Structured workouts include complete stages; inspect listDetail. Splits are detail-only via getActivityDetailFromDB. Use full=true for bounded comparisons; on too_large, retry smaller windows.

parameters.name: oldest
parameters.description: Start boundary date (YYYY-MM-DD), inclusive.

parameters.name: newest
parameters.description: End boundary date (YYYY-MM-DD). For calendar windows, use the day after the last desired date.

parameters.name: days
parameters.description: Relative days window. Prefer oldest/newest for planning history.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Max completed trainings per page. Historical calendar context does not consume this limit.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Pagination offset for completed trainings. Historical calendar context is returned only when offset=0 to avoid repetition on every training page; prefer non-overlapping date windows for historical analysis.

parameters.name: full
parameters.description: Optional analysis-rich but bounded list mode for comparing multiple workouts. listDetail reports returned, truncated, and budget-omitted sections. This is not raw data or the exact detailed view for one workout; use getActivityDetailFromDB after selecting one training_id.

200.description: Bounded chronological union of completed training and calendar-context items. Each training may include stages: a complete compact table of meaningful workout stages; listDetail accounting applies only to training items.

413.description: The requested training and calendar window exceeds the safe response budget

502.description: Upstream error, auth error, or invalid upstream response

get.summary: Get full user summary via gateway in up to three parts
get.description: Read part 1. If partial, read parts 2..parts with expectedVersion=summaryVersion, merge data, then answer. On version_mismatch restart. goalsProjection.view=compact_v1: join item.id to profile.goalItems.publicId; omitted goal fields are duplicate/inherited/empty. Use data.chatFooter exactly.

parameters.name: part
parameters.description: Optional part number. Omit this parameter or use 1 first. After a partial response, request each remaining part through the declared parts value with its summaryVersion.

parameters.name: expectedVersion
parameters.description: Required when part is 2 or 3. Use the summaryVersion returned by part 1.

200.description: Complete summary or one part of a two- or three-part summary

404.description: Small error response when the summary is unavailable

409.description: The summary version changed; restart with part=1

413.description: The summary cannot fit into three safe parts

post.description: An explicit request to save the exact strategy markdown is sufficient confirmation. Call once with the final markdown. The server stores it and refreshes the summary internally. Do not read summary, preview, or read back in the save turn.

get.summary: Read editable goals, starts, and results
get.description: Read goals/results only when needed to identify an existing target or compose a draft. Do not call this after explicit save intent; applyGoalResultChange reads the current version internally.

get.summary: Read eligible activities for one start
get.description: Read exact activity candidates before linking a completed start to an activity. Use only an event goal public ID from getEditableGoalsResults.

parameters.name: goal_id
parameters.description: Event goal public ID.

get.summary: Read one profile change in full
get.description: Load exact old/new text and hashes for one record selected from readProfileChangeHistory. This is read-only.

post.summary: Validate and save one profile memory section
post.description: An explicit request to save the exact profile or rules change is sufficient confirmation. Call once with the final payload. Gateway reads, validates, and commits internally. Do not call profile reads, previews, or readback in the save turn.

200.description: Profile section saved or already identical

409.description: Current data conflicts with the requested change

post.summary: Validate and apply one goals or results change
post.description: An explicit request to save the exact goal or result change is sufficient confirmation. Call once with the final command. Gateway reads the current version, previews, and commits internally. Do not read, preview, commit, or read back separately in the save turn.

409.description: Current data conflicts with the requested change

user_id.description: Intervals athlete id resolved from OAuth token

ChatFooter.description: Authoritative footer for the final answer. Render these exact links after a Markdown divider. If absent, omit the footer and never invent links.

UserSummaryData.description: Model-facing athlete Summary. When goalsProjection.view=compact_v1, join goalsProjection.items[].id to profile.goalItems[].publicId; omitted item fields duplicate that goal row, inherit profile.timezone, or are null/false/empty optional values. goalsProjection owns lifecycle, result, trust, attention and completeness facts.

section.description: Choose profile for athlete facts, goals for targets, rules for constraints. Do not mix sections.

birthYear.description: Birth year. Omit to preserve; null only to clear.

gender.description: Gender from the web profile form. Omit to preserve; null only to clear.

height.description: Height in cm. Omit to preserve; null only to clear.

weight.description: Weight in kg. Omit to preserve; null only to clear.

maxHr.description: Maximum heart rate. Omit to preserve; null only to clear.

ltHr.description: Lactate-threshold heart rate. Omit to preserve; null only to clear.

otherSports.description: Other sports. Omit to preserve; null only to clear.

raceResults.description: Race PR list. If provided, replaces the whole list; [] or null clears it. Omit to preserve.

additional.description: Additional durable profile context. Do not use for firstName.

trainingsPerWeek.description: Exact single number for Тренировок в неделю. Do not send ranges, minimums, maximums, or flexible wording here.

offDays.description: Exact single number for Выходных. Do not send ranges, minimums, maximums, or flexible wording here.

restDays.description: Fixed rest weekdays for Дни отдыха, only when the user names fixed weekdays.

customRules.description: Separate durable custom rules. The server writes one Правило line per item.

newText.description: Server-rendered exact full text proposed or committed by the change. Do not send newText in preview requests.

start_date_local.description: Local start datetime without timezone suffix, e.g. 2026-02-16T09:00:00

end_date_local.description: Local end datetime without timezone suffix. For NOTE all-day: next day T00:00:00

category.description: WORKOUT for training, NOTE for context/rest/illness. Defaults to WORKOUT if omitted.

type.description: Title Case activity type. Required for WORKOUT. Omit for NOTE.

description.description: Structured multi-line description. For structured workouts, use native Intervals.icu workout text lines, for example '- 10m Z2 HR'. HR-only workouts must use HR targets such as Z2 HR, not pace or power.

moving_time.description: Duration in seconds. For WORKOUT only, omit for NOTE.

icu_training_load.description: Estimated training load. For WORKOUT only, omit for NOTE. Intervals.icu may store load but return icu_atl/icu_ctl as null or exclude/partially weight non-cardio/support types in Fitness/Fatigue depending on athlete settings.

external_id.description: Stable unique ID for upsert/update, e.g. plan:2026-03-11:easy-run or note:2026-03-11:illness. Reuse the same value when editing an existing event.

for_week.description: For NOTE only: mark the note as applying to the whole week.

target.description: Optional Intervals workout target. Use HR for heart-rate-only structured workouts, PACE for pace-led run workouts, and POWER for power-led workouts. If omitted, STAS infers it from description when possible.

TrainingFull.description: Bounded comparative list projection of one completed training. When stages is present it contains all meaningful workout stages in compact columns-plus-rows form. Kilometre splits are intentionally omitted from getTrainings; use getActivityDetailFromDB for exact splits and richer detail about one selected workout.

pace.description: Average pace in seconds per kilometre when available.

stages.description: Complete compact table of meaningful workout stages when available. Read columns once, then map every row by position. This is the preferred AI structure; it preserves warmup, work, recovery, and cooldown without repeating field names.

intervalSummary.description: Fallback saved semantic markup, returned only when stages is unavailable; use listDetail.intervalSummary to see truncation.

workSignals.description: Derived training-work signal. facts vary by sport and available data.

listDetail.description: Accounting for this bounded list projection. It reports rows returned, truncation, and fields omitted under the response budget; use getActivityDetailFromDB for one exact selected workout.

maxTrainingTime.description: Maximum available training duration in seconds.

TrainingStages.description: Compact table. columns declares the order once; each row has values in that exact order. Core columns are number, type, distance, duration, pace, avgHr, maxHr. Detail responses may append only columns with real source values.

ActivityDetailResponse.description: AI-ready detailed passport for one completed workout. Prefer stages for the complete readable stage table; detail may append available metrics. Raw source payloads, route coordinates, latlng, and raw stream arrays are intentionally omitted.

redactions.description: Confirms that raw source payloads, raw streams, route coordinates, and latlng were omitted.

workIntervalsSummary.description: Backward-compatible protected summary. Prefer stages when present.

stages.description: Complete compact table of this workout's meaningful stages. Detail responses may include additional columns when the source recorded them.

flags.description: Detected issues or notable conditions, for example uphill, pace_drop, hr_drift, missing_hr, weak_altitude, terrain_mismatch.

sourceActivityId.description: Source activity id if available; not a route or raw payload.

userReport.description: User self-report for the workout if available.

ActivityDetailListSection.description: Limited list section. available is the full detected count; returned is how many items are included in this response.

ActivityDetailWorkIntervalSummaryItem.description: One compact workout interval summary item.

ActivityDetailItem.description: One detailed interval, lap, split, best effort, or segment item. Fields vary by section.

maxGradePct.description: Maximum grade percent for the item when available from Intervals or derived from altitude/distance streams.

redactions.description: Confirms that raw source payloads, raw streams, and route coordinates were omitted.

note.description: Generic object; actual keys may vary by workout and data source.

GoalResultEditCommand.description: One canonical command. Choose command.type only from the listed oneOf variants; aliases such as create, update, delete, add_goal, or update_goal are invalid.

oneOf.description: Canonical general_create command. Send this exact command.type and no alias.
Canonical general_update command. Send this exact command.type and no alias.
Canonical general_archive command. Send this exact command.type and no alias.
Canonical start_create command. Send this exact command.type and no alias.

anyOf.description: Target time only, formatted as MM:SS or H:MM:SS.

oneOf.description: Canonical start_update command. Send this exact command.type and no alias.

anyOf.description: Target time only, formatted as MM:SS or H:MM:SS.

oneOf.description: Canonical start_delete command. Send this exact command.type and no alias.
Canonical start_cancel command. Send this exact command.type and no alias.
Canonical start_dns command. Send this exact command.type and no alias.
Canonical result_set command. Send this exact command.type and no alias.
Canonical result_link_activity command. Send this exact command.type and no alias.
Canonical result_detach_activity command. Send this exact command.type and no alias.
Create a standalone result. Multiple results for the same sport and distance are allowed.
Update one existing standalone result. Use the resultPublicId returned in manualResults.
Canonical manual_result_delete command. Send this exact command.type and no alias.
Canonical legacy_result_convert command. Send this exact command.type and no alias.
Canonical legacy_result_delete command. Send this exact command.type and no alias.

section.description: Save exactly one profile memory section.

structured.description: Final structured change for the selected section.

diffSummary.description: Short factual summary of the requested change. Do not include raw chat.
